name: pact-lsp
description: Language support for Pact, the session-typed extension of AnvilHDL: diagnostics, navigation, completion and session-state hints.
author: Wern Lim <dev@wern.cc>

pact.maxNumberOfProblems.description: Controls the maximum number of problems produced by the server.

pact.projectRoot.description: Controls the project root path. Defaults to the workspace root.

pact.executablePath.description: Path to the Pact compiler binary. Defaults to 'pact' in your PATH.

pact.compilerArgs.description: Extra flags passed to the Pact compiler, e.g. ["-strict-dtc"].

pact.compatibilityChecks.description: Run pool compatibility checks during diagnostics. Off by default because they can take minutes on large pools.

pact.compileTimeout.description: Milliseconds before a compiler run is stopped and reported as timed out. 0 disables the limit.

pact.asciiOnlyIcons.description: Use ASCII-only characters instead of Unicode when displaying symbols or icons.

pact.showTimingInfo.description: Controls how clock-cycle timing and expression lifetime information is shown in the editor.

oneOf.description: `true` enables timing info as condensed inlay hints and on hover. `false` disables all timing info.
Fine-grained control over where clock-cycle timing and lifetime information appears.

asInlayHints.description: Show clock-cycle timings and expression lifetimes as inline annotations in the editor gutter.

enumDescriptions: Do not show timing info as inlay hints.
Show timing info as compact prefixed and postfixed inlay hints.
Show timing info in full phrases as prefixed and postfixed inlay hints.

oneOf.description: `true` is equivalent to `"condensed"`. `false` is equivalent to `"none"`.

onHover.description: Show clock-cycle timing and lifetime information when hovering over an expression.

includeUnknownVariableDefinitions.description: Include unresolved timing variable definitions such as `n1, n2 = ?` in hover and autocomplete timing definitions blocks.

onAutocomplete.description: Show clock-cycle timing and lifetime information in autocomplete documentation popups.

pact.showProcessTypes.description: Show each process's type above its definition: its declared interfaces, or the type inferred from its threads.

pact.showSessionState.description: Controls where the remaining session type of session-checked threads is shown.

oneOf.description: `true` shows session states as inlay hints and on hover. `false` hides them.
Fine-grained control over where session states appear.

asInlayHints.description: Show the remaining session type after each statement that advances the session, and at the start of each offer arm.

onHover.description: Show the session type before and after an expression when hovering over it.

pact.showSyntaxHelp.description: Controls whether explanations of Pact syntax are shown in hover tooltips and autocomplete popups.

oneOf.description: `true` enables all explanations in all areas. `false` disables all explanations.
Fine-grained control over where Pact concept explanations appear.

onHover.description: Show Pact explanations when hovering over nodes.

onAutocomplete.description: Show Pact explanations in autocomplete documentation popups.

enumDescriptions: Never show explanations in autocomplete popups.
Show explanations only for built-in Pact keywords and operators.
Show explanations for all completions, including user-defined identifiers.

oneOf.description: `true` is equivalent to `"all"`. `false` is equivalent to `"none"`.

includeExamples.description: When `true`, code examples from the Pact language reference are included in syntax help explanations. Only applies when syntax explanations are active.

pact.trace.server.description: Traces the communication between VS Code and the language server.

scripts.postinstall: cd client && npm install && cd ../server && npm install && cd ..
